landing.heroSubtitle: MindBridge connects psychiatrists and psychologists with their patients for daily mental health tracking, real-time alerts, and secure messaging -- all in one calm, focused platform.
landing.features.title: Everything you need for continuous care
landing.features.subtitle: Simple, secure tools for both practitioners and patients.
landing.features.journaling.title: Daily Journaling
landing.features.journaling.description: Patients log mood, sleep, anxiety, and medication daily with an intuitive, low-friction form.
landing.features.analytics.title: Visual Analytics
landing.features.analytics.description: Practitioners see mood trends, sleep patterns, and medication adherence in clear, actionable charts.
landing.features.alerts.title: Smart Alerts
landing.features.alerts.description: Automatic alerts when mood drops, medication is missed, or sleep becomes critically low.
landing.features.messaging.title: Secure Messaging
landing.features.messaging.description: Direct messaging between practitioner and patient for quick check-ins between appointments.
landing.features.access.title: Role-Based Access
landing.features.access.description: Patients see only their own data. Practitioners see only their assigned patients.
landing.features.calm.title: Calming Experience
landing.features.calm.description: Designed for minimal cognitive load with a clean, accessible interface that puts wellbeing first.
landing.demo.title: Try the demo accounts
landing.demo.subtitle: Explore MindBridge instantly with pre-loaded demo data. No registration required.
